# CraftEgon Corporate Services (CCS)

> From business establishment to managing what comes next, CraftEgon Corporate Services (CCS) helps businesses navigate registrations, pre-launch approvals, commercial documentation, and ongoing corporate compliance.

- Website: https://ccs.craftegon.com/
- Operating Brand: CraftEgon Corporate Services (CCS)
- Parent Legal Entity: CraftEgon LLP (LLPIN: ACO-0239, incorporated 30 April 2025)
- Contact Desk: admin@craftegon.com | +91 86069 18247

- MCA Registered Office: 92/D, Thiruthummal Panakkad, Chettipadi, Tirurangadi, Malappuram, Kerala - 676319, India
- Primary Regulators Referenced: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), Registrar of Companies (RoC), K-SWIFT, LSGD Kerala, KSPCB, Income Tax Department, GSTN, CGPDTM, Ministry of MSME, DGFT.

## Five Core Industry Solutions (Kerala)

- [Clinics, Diagnostics & Care Centers](https://ccs.craftegon.com/bundles/clinics-diagnostics-kerala.html): Entity structuring, K-SWIFT & Kerala Clinical Establishments readiness, KSPCB BMW workflows, doctor/equipment agreements, and ongoing healthcare tax compliance.
- [EXIM, Freight & Cold-Chain Logistics](https://ccs.craftegon.com/bundles/exim-cold-chain-kerala.html): DGFT IEC, ICEGATE & port AD Code linkage, GST Export LUT, commodity RCMCs, warehouse clearances, CHA/cold-chain contracts, and FEMA/EDPMS compliance.
- [Food, Spice & Agri Processing](https://ccs.craftegon.com/bundles/food-spice-processing-kerala.html): Incorporation & MSME Udyam (Sec 43B(h)), K-SWIFT & KSPCB CTE/CTO dossiers, FSSAI licensing, co-packing & distributor contracts, and multi-HSN GST coordination.
- [Hospitality, Stays & Resorts](https://ccs.craftegon.com/bundles/hospitality-resorts-kerala.html): Resident/NRI SPV formation, LSGD occupancy, KSPCB STP/DG & Fire checklists, FSSAI kitchen licensing, lease & operator agreements, and OTA/POS accounting alignment.
- [EdTech & Training Institutes](https://ccs.craftegon.com/bundles/edtech-academies-kerala.html): Pvt Ltd/LLP/Section 8 setup, DPIIT Startup readiness, Class 41/42 trademarks, faculty IP assignment contracts, DPDP student privacy, and refund governance.

## Underlying Business Services Catalogue (57 Routes)

- [Universal Services Directory](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services.html): Complete 57-route catalogue mapped across Phase 1 (Start Right), Phase 2 (Put the Essentials in Place), Phase 3 (Stay on Track), Specialist Transactions, and Referral-Only Dispute Guidance.
- [Kerala Vertical Readiness Estimator](https://ccs.craftegon.com/conversion/calculator.html#readiness): Interactive tool identifying indicative sector, premises, contract, and governance requirements.
- [Private Limited Company Registration](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services/pvt-ltd-registration.html): SPICe+ (INC-32) MCA incorporation, DINs, e-MOA/e-AOA, PAN/TAN, and bank resolution documentation for any client-selected bank.
- [Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Registration](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services/llp-registration.html): FiLLiP MCA filing, DPINs, custom LLP Agreement (Form 3), and statutory onboarding.
- [RoC Annual Compliance & Secretarial Retainer](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services/roc-annual-compliance.html): Form AOC-4, MGT-7/7A, DIR-3 KYC (Rule 12A), statutory registers, and board documentation coordination.
- [Trademark Registration (Form TM-A)](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services/trademark-registration.html): Prior-mark guidance and Form TM-A filing coordination under the Trade Marks Act, 1999.
- [MSME / Udyam Registration](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services/msme-udyam.html): Official Udyam classification and Section 43B(h) buyer-payment protection support.
- [Fast-Track Company Strike-Off (Form STK-2)](https://ccs.craftegon.com/services/form-stk2-strike-off.html): Voluntary closure support under Section 248 of the Companies Act, 2013.

## Regulatory, Commercial & Independence Boundaries

- **Fee Separation:** CCS professional coordination fees are itemized separately from statutory government fees, state stamp duties, and third-party engineer/lab/audit charges (payable at actuals). Final bundle pricing requires written quotation under diagnostic scoping.
- **No Guaranteed Outcomes:** Final statutory approvals, inspections, and clearance timelines rest exclusively with competent government authorities.
- **Banking Independence:** CraftEgon LLP / CCS has zero banking partnerships, commissions, or exclusive bank tie-ups.
- **Independent Practitioners & Advocates Act 1961:** Statutory audit reports, UDIN certifications, and mandated professional attestations are performed by qualified independent professionals. Courtroom and NCLT tribunal litigation is outside CCS scope and referred strictly to independent enrolled advocates on a separate vakalatnama.
- **DPDP Act 2023:** Client enquiry and compliance records are handled under privacy consent requirements without unauthorized sharing.
